scene: The binoculars reveal three transit lines leaving the harbor.
picture: The young Black woman in yellow raincoat, green boots, and red umbrella stands at centre. On the far left, a lit subway entrance stairwell leads down. Left of centre sits the crane binocular. To the right, a red street tram waits on rails. Up high, a yellow cable car hangs ready at a high platform.
shown: a glowing subway entrance stairwell with open gate on the far left
a painted red street tram idling at a platform on the right
a glass-bottomed cable car dangling from an overhead wire up high
